lines.t: Consider my love, behold my hands and my feet, and consider my love.
For the scars of my passion remain, a holy, everlasting covenant written in the blood of the
Lamb. Taste and see, beloved, drink, until that which is veiled is veiled no longer,
until the void within your heart is filled. For my love was written in every stripe I endured
for you, poured out in every drop of blood I shed for you, revealed when you pierced my hands
and my feet. Beloved, I am married unto you. A union sealed forever in the blood we share.
